free_tier.stated: No free tier: the dedicated M6 GitHub Actions runner is $139/mo with unlimited macOS build minutes and no meter, cancel anytime; a by-the-day rental of the same M6 is $15 for up to 6 days.
free_tier.notes: The provider list's $0.19 an hour is $139 a month divided by 730 hours. The agent plan on the same M6 is $169 a month. Annual billing is 10 months for 12.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a dedicated Mac mini with 16 GB memory and 256 GB storage, not an object; no per-artifact cap is published

retention.stated: the Mac is wiped when the time is up and the user can cancel anytime from the portal; no separate retention period for files left on the machine is stated

egress.terms: unverified: no egress allowance, data cap or price is stated on the pages read; the machine is in the vendor's own facility in New Jersey, United States

interface_detail: GitHub Actions ready via a registered self-hosted runner; GitLab, Bitbucket, Buildkite and Jenkins also work; a desktop session opens from a browser tab and SSH is enabled by accepting a Tailscale invite emailed to the user
tooling: a GitHub Actions runner registered on the dedicated Mac with a config.sh command, Xcode selection and cache paths; the user installs and runs the runner agent on the rented Mac, which is the hosted offer
chaining: the always-on M6 runs unlimited macOS builds as a self-hosted GitHub Actions runner with pinned Xcode and warm local SSD caches, and the same machine can be leased as an agent Mac; state that must outlive the lease belongs in a separate storage record.

limits.value: $139 a month for the M6 runner plan with unlimited macOS build minutes; no per-minute meter

limits_note: the M4 runner is $119 a month and the M5 Pro runner $269 a month before a $199 build fee; the day rental is $15 for up to 6 days and the week rental is $59 for up to 4 weeks; prices are grandfathered.
binding_note: the flat monthly price with an unlimited build-minute allowance is the only published ceiling; there is no per-minute or byte quota to bind first.

identity_cost.detail: the signup form asks for Name, Email and an optional GitHub org or repo URL, and states 'Secure checkout via Stripe. After payment we provision your machine and email you when it's ready.' The pricing page says pay by card and a full refund in the first 3 days on email request.

reliability_note: the machine is wiped when the lease ends; the vendor offers a full refund within the first 3 days by email and states a 3-day pre-order window, with live uptime on its status page
confidence_note: prices, unlimited build minutes, hardware, signup fields and payment rail are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-25; the signup fields were read but no rental was made.
